fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! David says the LORD did it "…that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent." (Psalm 30:12) Look at where the verse ends up. It doesn't stop at the dancing. It lands on praise and on thanks: "O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever." (Psalm 30:12) The sackcloth came off so the singing could start, and David plans to keep it going forever.

problems.problem: The explanation still mostly repeats the answer. The fresh-batch comparison adds little insight into David's praise and thanksgiving.
